claims.summary: For X_1..X_N i.i.d. uniform on [0,1]^2 and a hierarchical transport of depth D >= 2m, m = floor(theta log_2 N), cutting each cell alternately in coordinates 1 and 2 through its interior point of rank r_C among n_C and its target at the fraction tau_C of its side, r_C and tau_C functions of the earlier cuts, the rule local at step j_0 = D - 2m, with (i) |tau_C - r_C/n_C| <= A/sqrt(n_C) for every cell, (ii) r_C/n_C and tau_C in [eps, 1 - eps] for every cell, (iii) final counts in [kappa log N, K log N], (iv) target aspect l'_{3-k} <= Gamma l'_k at the fine steps cutting k, and 0 < theta < 1/(2 lambda + 2 log_2(1/eps)), lambda = log_2(1/(p eps^2)), p = 64^(-ceil(128 x^2)), x = (A + 1/2)/sqrt((1 - delta) eps (1 - eps)) for a free delta in (0, 1): for every L, M > 0 and alpha in (2, infinity], with probability tending to one every permutation pi and points Y with |Y^k_pi(i) - T^k(X_i)| <= m/(18 sqrt(Gamma N)) for the interior points have sum_i psi_alpha(|X_i^k - Y^k_pi(i)|/s) >= MN, s = L sqrt(log N/N) (for alpha = infinity a displacement beyond s). Implies thm:adapted-partition-obstruction (its class is the case tau = 1/2) and covers targets split in proportion to the counts with steering up to n^(3/4) points per cut; at every pair of the curve such matchings fail the conjecture's conclusion for every L.
claims.assessment: Working proof: the cell means of the displacement walk with a common step xi = (tau - c) l'/2 (c the pivot's relative position) and deviations (1 - c)(l - l')/2, -c(l - l')/2 of zero area-weighted sum, so a chain follows a predictable child; the order statistic deviates from tau by 1/(4 sqrt n) in each sign with conditional probability at least p by lem:block-lower-tail and (i), (ii); capacities n_C/(N|Q_C|) stay within e^(+-2 gamma_N), gamma_N -> 0, by (i), (ii) and the geometric growth of counts; with (iv) the push is at least 1/(9 sqrt(Gamma N)); count weights at least eps, Chebyshev over the step-j_0 cells by locality, and the affine symmetry on final cells carry the walk to the sample points, as in thm:adapted-partition-obstruction.
claims.rationale: Closes, at every pair of the curve, the matchings that follow, up to m/(18 sqrt(Gamma N)), a hierarchical transport whose target splits, fixed before each cut, stay within A/sqrt(n) of its count splits, with splits bounded away from 0 and 1, final counts within constants and targets of bounded aspect; not covered: target splits chosen after the cut or farther from the count splits, steering by a fixed fraction at a fixed depth, cell-dependent depths, targets of unbounded aspect, non-local rules, partitions of both samples, matchings farther from the transport, and constructions not built from hierarchical transports.
claims.next_action: Target splits following the cut partly, tau = q + w(c - q) with a fixed w < 1: show that every w < 1 falls to the walk (outline checked by hand); tau = c at every cut makes the transport the identity, the goal itself.
